Please note, there is a discrepancy between the ’22 Election Results (published on Election Day by the States Greffe) and Electoral Statistics (created by Statistics Jersey).

The figures the States Greffe started with (60,701) compared with Election Day (60,678) is a total of 23, which is believed to be linked to deaths and people leaving the Island.

You can head to the [News](https://www.vote.je/news) section of Vote,je for a further breakdown of the results, including [register voter numbers](https://www.vote.je/news/election-2022-registered-voter-numbers/).
